evidence.observation: Append located rows to a locally owned fact under additive preview and apply.
Choose append-only in-model storage or the external population requested in #338. The external option changes the atomic publication and summary contract and requires revising CG1.

concerns.recommendation: Resolve the open decision on storage location (in-model vs external) before approving the plan, as CG1 requires this decision to proceed and currently hardcodes a conflicting state.
concerns.title: Contradiction between CG1 definition and open decision for source ownership

evidence.observation: Keep prior rows and spans intact and validate the extended population.

concerns.recommendation: Explicitly define the failure mode, reporting mechanism, and resolution path for conflicting constraints (e.g., cardinality or type violations) when validating the extended population.
concerns.title: Missing resolution for conflicting constraints during append

evidence.observation: After a rename or deletion validate all role references and locate every transferred row’s original source.

concerns.recommendation: Add a falsifiable test case that intentionally interrupts or fails a role rewrite to verify that the operation rolls back atomically without partial state changes.
concerns.title: Missing falsifiable case for atomic rewrite failure

evidence.observation: recompute candidates after apply and stop at the configured threshold.
Record work counters and the first refusal where limits apply.

concerns.recommendation: Specify the exact unit of the 'configured threshold' and limits (e.g., max loop iterations, processed candidates) to establish a clear, falsifiable limit for bounded work in the consolidation loop.
concerns.title: Ambiguous threshold unit for bounded work limit

response.summary: The plan establishes a clear phase structure but contains a blocking contradiction on source ownership and lacks necessary details for constraint conflicts and atomicity verification.
